title: Rep looks up the spares deal then appends a line item
userProblem: I need to add a spare parts kit to the spares support contract dls_006 for Acme. First confirm the deal, then add one spare parts kit at 8000 EUR each.

expectedOutcome.description: Agent looks up dls_006, appends one line item (spare parts kit, qty 1, unit 8000 EUR), and confirms the deal total is consistent.

assertions.description: Agent must look the deal up first.
Agent must create the line item after lookup.
Line item targets the right deal and product.
Seed has 2 line items for dls_006, we add 1.
Deal total must equal sum of line items after the add.
Trace must follow the multi-step shape: search then create.

rationale: Core multi-step scenario: lookup then create, verifying both steps execute in order.
